cases.purpose: run-shutdown: bounded service-child cleanup and monitored session
cases.oracle: Documented service and firewall request contracts, independently checked fixture services, private peers and explicit event/order assertions. Independent forced-cleanup and parent-death controls verify exact child reaping and must fail the candidate-cleanup predicate.
cases.comparison: Statuses and normalized observations are checked against fixed expectations; raw input, output, event order, PIDs, peer data and fixture controls are retained for review. Pre-cleanup process snapshots, raw child events, trap actions and subreaper wait statuses are retained; any forced cleanup or live survivor is a failure.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home && -O /tmp/parity-case && -O /tmp/parity-home && -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor ]] || { echo 'not a disposable parity guest' >&2; exit 98; }
marker=$(< /etc/bashos-parity-vm); vendor=$(< /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor)
[[ $marker =~ ^[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}$ && $vendor == QEMU ]] || { echo 'guest identity mismatch' >&2; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/cp /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/services-supervisor-r2.py "$HOME/sv-helper"
/usr/bin/chmod 700 "$HOME/sv-helper"
"$HOME/sv-helper" --setup run
"$HOME/sv-helper" --cleanup-controls run

files.case-inner.sh:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home && -O /tmp/parity-case && -O /tmp/parity-home && -r /etc/bashos-parity-vm && -r /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor ]] || { echo 'not a disposable parity guest' >&2; exit 98; }
marker=$(< /etc/bashos-parity-vm); vendor=$(< /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor)
[[ $marker =~ ^[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}$ && $vendor == QEMU ]] || { echo 'guest identity mismatch' >&2; exit 98; }
fixture_exit() {
 local code=$?
 trap - EXIT TERM INT HUP
 "$HOME/sv-helper" --trap-cleanup > "$HOME/trap.out" 2> "$HOME/trap.err" || code=1
 exit "$code"
}
trap fixture_exit EXIT
trap 'exit 124' TERM INT HUP
for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do [[ -s $HOME/monitor-context.json ]] && break; /usr/bin/sleep .02; done
[[ -s $HOME/monitor-context.json ]] || exit 98
export BASHSV_DIR="$HOME/services" BASHSV_RUNDIR="$HOME/state" BASHSV_LOGDIR="$HOME/logs"
wait_file() { for ((i=0;i<120;i++)); do [[ -s $1 ]] && return 0; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done; return 1; }
wait_contains() { local file=$1 text=$2; for ((i=0;i<120;i++)); do [[ -r $file && $(< "$file") == *"$text"* ]] && return 0; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done; return 1; }
wait_stopped() { local file="$HOME/state/$1/super-pid"; for ((i=0;i<120;i++)); do [[ ! -e $file ]] && return 0; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done; return 1; }
( sv boot > "$HOME/boot.out" 2> "$HOME/boot.err"; printf '%s\n' "$?" > "$HOME/boot.status" ) & owner=$!
wait_file "$HOME/started.a_notify" && echo notify-service=started || echo notify-service=BAD
[[ ! -e $HOME/started.z_dependent ]] && echo gate=held || echo gate=BAD
: > "$HOME/notify.ready"
wait_contains "$HOME/state/a_notify/status" 'ready pid=' && /usr/bin/cp "$HOME/state/a_notify/status" "$HOME/status.ready" && /usr/bin/cp "$HOME/state/a_notify/pid" "$HOME/pid.ready" && echo ready=observed || echo ready=BAD
wait "$owner"; printf 'boot=%s\n' "$(< "$HOME/boot.status")"
: > "$HOME/notify.reload"
wait_contains "$HOME/state/a_notify/status" 'reloading pid=' && /usr/bin/cp "$HOME/state/a_notify/status" "$HOME/status.reload" && echo reload=observed || echo reload=BAD
: > "$HOME/notify.stopping"
wait_contains "$HOME/state/a_notify/status" 'stopping pid=' && /usr/bin/cp "$HOME/state/a_notify/status" "$HOME/status.stopping" && echo stopping=observed || echo stopping=BAD
if "$HOME/sv-helper" --safe-tree; then sv shutdown > "$HOME/shutdown.out" 2> "$HOME/shutdown.err"; printf 'shutdown=%s\n' "$?"; else echo shutdown=UNSAFE; fi
"$HOME/sv-helper" --check notify
